question: Who is the director of the Indian entry at the 78th Cannes Film Festival named ‘Homebound’, starring Janhvi Kapoor, Ishaan Khatter and Vishal Jethwa?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Neeraj Ghaywan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Neeraj Ghaywan** is a critically acclaimed Indian filmmaker known for his unique storytelling and socially relevant themes.
 
• He gained prominence with his award-winning debut feature film **Masaan (2015)**, which won two awards at the Cannes Film Festival in the Un Certain Regard section.
 
• The Indian entry at the 78th Cannes Film Festival, **'Homebound'**, starring Janhvi Kapoor, Ishaan Khatter, and Vishal Jethwa, was directed by Neeraj Ghaywan.
 
• Neeraj's filmmaking style is often noted for its nuanced portrayal of emotions and societal issues, making his work resonate with both critics and audiences globally.
 
• He has also contributed to popular OTT platforms, directing episodes in critically acclaimed series like **"Sacred Games"** and **"Made in Heaven."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Karan Johar**

 
 
• A prominent Bollywood filmmaker, producer, and screenwriter known for directing and producing popular films under his production house Dharma Productions.
 
• Some of his iconic works include **Kuch Kuch Hota Hai**, **Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham**, and **My Name is Khan**.
 
• He is also a notable television host and mentor to many young actors in the Indian film industry.
 
 
 
• **Anurag Kashyap**
 
 
• A renowned filmmaker and screenwriter, known for his edgy and unconventional storytelling style.
 
• His notable works include **Gangs of Wasseypur**, **Black Friday**, and **Dev.D**.
 
• He has been a strong proponent of independent cinema in India and has also directed segments of anthology films like **Lust Stories** and **Ghost Stories**.
 
 
 
• **Anurag Basu**
 
 
• A celebrated filmmaker known for his unique narrative style and visually appealing films.
 
• Some of his notable works include **Barfi!**, **Life in a... Metro**, and **Ludo**.
 
• He is known for his ability to blend emotions, drama, and humor effectively in his films.
 
 
 
• **About the Cannes Film Festival:**
 
 
• The Cannes Film Festival is one of the most prestigious international film festivals held annually in Cannes, France.
 
• It showcases films from across the globe, celebrating excellence in filmmaking, storytelling, and artistic expression.
 
• The festival awards include the **Palme d'Or**, Grand Prix, and Best Director, among others.
